value.signature: fn bind < 'a > (bound : & 'a BoundProcedure < '_ > , input : Inputs , verifier : & impl ReferenceVerifier ,) -> Result < BoundReference < 'a > , Error >

review.body: { bound . preflight () ? ; let (_ , procedure) = bound . inputs () ; pn_graph :: numeric :: wall :: check_declaration (procedure , & input) ? ; if ! verifier . published_reference (procedure , & input) { return Err (Error :: Publication) ; } Ok (BoundReference { procedure , input }) }
review.item_premise: Public reference inputs, immutable bound procedure, rational enclosures and scalar attachments only. Queries are rebuilt before certificate checks. Results and refusals expose no secret or price mutation.
